title: Independent painting contractors
hypothesis: A person-form Colorado registered agent on a painting-positive entity is an identity candidate only. Contractor fit, explicit independent ownership evidence, and a separately verified published business contact are required before delivery; neither the agent record nor a business number establishes an owner mobile.
ownerSource: Colorado SOS entity record (4ykn-tg5h) for role-labeled registered-agent candidates, followed by independent public ownership evidence. No owner-confirming painting adapter is implemented.
phoneSource: The live recipe-A route starts with a published Maps business number. It is a business-contact candidate only and was not phone-tested in this free review.

workflow.label: Colorado painting entity
workflow.detail: Start with a Good Standing Colorado entity record whose name is painting-positive; retain the registered-agent role, never an owner label.

workflow.label: Painting contractor fit
workflow.detail: Require contractor-oriented painting evidence; paint stores, art/studio, manufacturing, generic contractor, and adjacent-only results do not pass.

workflow.label: Non-contractor or ambiguous
workflow.detail: Hold or reject records without painting-contractor evidence.

workflow.label: Independent brand check
workflow.detail: Route CertaPro, Five Star Painting, WOW 1 DAY, Fresh Coat, and 360 Painting matches to franchise review.

workflow.label: Franchise review
workflow.detail: Hold the brand match; a franchisee may be local but is not owner-confirmed by the brand pattern.

workflow.label: Registered-agent form
workflow.detail: Separate a person-form agent from an organization agent. Either is a registry role, not ownership evidence.

workflow.label: Organization agent
workflow.detail: Hold organization-agent records; do not infer an owner from a filing service or organization name.

workflow.label: Person agent candidate
workflow.detail: Keep the named person as an owner candidate with the registered-agent role attached.

workflow.label: Independent ownership proof
workflow.detail: Seek explicit public evidence that the person owns the same painting contractor; a registry role, review mention, or staff listing alone does not pass.

workflow.label: Ownership unproven
workflow.detail: Keep only a business-contact candidate; do not create an owner lead.

workflow.label: Owner-confirmed business
workflow.detail: Record the independently supported ownership evidence separately from the phone.

workflow.label: Published business contact
workflow.detail: Associate a published business number with the confirmed business; it is still not evidence of a direct owner handset.

workflow.label: Phone and compliance gates
workflow.detail: Require mobile classification, reachability, DNC/TCPA clearance, suppression and duplicate checks, while preserving ownership evidence as a separate gate.

workflow.label: Deliver confirmed contact
workflow.detail: Deliver only when owner confirmation and every required contact/compliance gate pass.

failures.risk: A registered agent is represented as the painting-business owner.
failures.mitigation: Persist the registered-agent role as owner-candidate evidence and require explicit, independent ownership proof.

failures.risk: Paint retail, art/studio, coatings manufacturer, or adjacent-only businesses are treated as painting contractors.
failures.mitigation: Require contractor-oriented painting evidence and hold non-contractor or ambiguous records.

failures.risk: A franchise brand is treated as an independent owner-operator.
failures.mitigation: Route known painting brands to franchise review without claiming franchisee ownership.

failures.risk: A published business, tracking, or VoIP number is called a direct owner mobile.
failures.mitigation: Keep phone identity separate from owner evidence and require the existing line, reachability, DNC, suppression, and duplicate gates.

failures.risk: Owner extraction begins before line type is known.
failures.mitigation: Select line_type in nameOwners and make extractOwnersForRows accept only explicit Mobile rows before free website or paid reviews work.

sources.label: Colorado SOS Business Entities
sources.scope: Colorado Good Standing painting-name entity records and registered-agent fields; no phone field

sources.label: Live painting recipe and classifier
sources.scope: National painting Maps-first discovery plus core/adjacent terms

sources.label: Painting franchise patterns and contact-risk treatment
sources.scope: Painting franchise segmentation, tracking/VoIP, duplicates, and language-routing boundaries

sources.label: Delivery phone gates
sources.scope: Mobile, reachability, DNC/TCPA, suppression, duplicate, and delivery checks

iterations.hypothesis: A person-form Colorado registered agent can be used as a painting owner candidate after a contractor-fit filter.
iterations.test: Free public 20-row Socrata sample, Good Standing entity names containing PAINT, retaining aggregate agent-form counts only on 2026-09-24.
iterations.observed: 17/20 sampled rows had a person-form agent and 3/20 had an organization agent. This measures field availability only; it does not verify contractor fit, ownership, a phone, mobile status, reachability, DNC, or delivery.
iterations.change: Use a role-labeled candidate branch with organization-agent hold and independent ownership proof. Do not use addresses or claim a phone relationship from the entity record.

iterations.test: Focused synthetic regression checks in tests/lead-engine-industry-corrections.test.ts, lead-engine-reviews.test.ts, lead-engine-gates-jobs.test.ts and lead-engine-jobs.test.ts. No paid provider call.
iterations.observed: Owner-name extraction now requires explicit Mobile evidence; undefined/null/Landline/VoIP inputs trigger no website fetch, meter or provider call. The runner reads verification.lineType, not a nonexistent job-row line_type column. It already selects delivered rows; the old omission was a helper-evidence default, not proof that production called unverified phones.
iterations.change: Shared runtime correction integrated. Original source samples are retained with their original denominators; no phone-yield improvement is claimed.

measurement.result: Colorado public entity endpoint sample: 17/20 person-form registered agents; 3/20 organization agents. Identity-field coverage only; no contact values retained and no phones verified.

cost.basis: Free public Colorado endpoint sample only; no paid discovery, append, review scrape, or phone verification ran.
cost.note: No owner-confirmed, clean contact outcome was measured; cost per clean contact is unknown.

implementation.summary: Owner-name extraction now requires explicit Mobile evidence; undefined/null/Landline/VoIP inputs trigger no website fetch, meter or provider call. The runner reads verification.lineType, not a nonexistent job-row line_type column. It already selects delivered rows; the old omission was a helper-evidence default, not proof that production called unverified phones. Original review: Painting is implemented only as the generic recipe-A discovery profile and relevance classifier. Colorado registry candidate ingestion, contractor/franchise filtering, independent owner confirmation, and an ownership delivery gate are proposed. Owner extraction currently defaults an unknown line type to Mobile.

nextMeasurement: After a lawful contractor/franchise classifier is implemented, run a free 5-20 row aggregate Colorado painting review with separate source, contractor-qualified, person-agent, independently owner-confirmed, published-business-contact, and authorized-line denominators. Do not use registry or residential addresses to discover personal phones.
